module asyn_fifo #(
    parameter	WIDTH = 8,
    parameter 	DEPTH = 16,
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = $clog2(DEPTH)
) (
    input 					wclk,
    input 					rclk,
    input 					wrstn,
    input					rrstn,
    input 					winc,
    input 			 		rinc,
    input 		[WIDTH-1:0]	wdata,
    output wire				wfull,
    output wire				rempty,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0]	rdata
);

endmodule

module dual_port_RAM #(parameter DEPTH = 16,  parameter WIDTH = 8)
(
	 input wclk	,
	 input wenc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] waddr  ,
	 input [WIDTH-1:0] wdata ,
	 input rclk	,
	 input renc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] raddr ,
	 output reg [WIDTH-1:0] rdata 		
);

reg [WIDTH-1:0] RAM_MEM [0:DEPTH-1];

always @(posedge wclk) begin
	if(wenc)
		RAM_MEM[waddr] <= wdata;
end 

always @(posedge rclk) begin
	if(renc)
		rdata <= RAM_MEM[raddr];
end 

endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>An asynchronous FIFO implemented using a dual-port RAM module and additional logic for managing read and write pointers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal used for synchronous write operations.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal used for synchronous read operations.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal. Used to trigger write operations.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal. Used to trigger read operations.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input. The width [WIDTH-1:0] is configurable and represents the data to be written into the FIFO.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal. Indicates if the FIFO is full and cannot accept further write operations.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal. Indicates if the FIFO is empty and cannot provide any data for read operations.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output. The width [WIDTH-1:0] is configurable and represents the data read from the FIFO.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH">Data width of the FIFO.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DEPTH">Depth of the FIFO.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        // Define parameters
        parameter WIDTH = 8;
        parameter DEPTH = 16;
        
        // Declare internal signals
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] RAM_MEM[0:DEPTH-1];
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] wdata_reg;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] rdata_reg;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] waddr_bin;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] raddr_bin;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] wptr;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] rptr;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] wptr_buff;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] rptr_buff;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] wptr_syn;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] rptr_syn;
        reg wen;
        reg ren;
        // Convert binary to Gray code
        function [WIDTH-1:0] bin_to_gray(input [WIDTH-1:0] bin);
            begin
                bin_to_gray = bin ^ (bin >> 1);
            end
        endfunction
        
        // Convert Gray code to binary
        function [WIDTH-1:0] gray_to_bin(input [WIDTH-1:0] gray);
            integer i;
            begin
                gray_to_bin[WIDTH-1] = gray[WIDTH-1];
                for (i = WIDTH-2; i >= 0; i = i - 1) begin
                    gray_to_bin[i] = gray_to_bin[i+1] ^ gray[i];
                end
            end
        endfunction
        
        // Assign outputs
        assign wfull = (wptr == {~rptr_syn[WIDTH-1], rptr_syn[WIDTH-2:0]});
        assign rempty = (rptr == wptr_syn);
        assign rdata = rdata_reg;
        
        // Dual-port RAM instance
        dual_port_RAM #(.WIDTH(WIDTH), .DEPTH(DEPTH)) ram (
            .wclk(wclk),
            .wenc(wen),
            .waddr(waddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0]),
            .wdata(wdata_reg),
            .rclk(rclk),
            .renc(ren),
            .raddr(raddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0]),
            .rdata(rdata_reg)
        );
        
        // Write pointer logic
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                waddr_bin <= 0;
                wptr <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (winc) begin
                    waddr_bin <= waddr_bin + 1;
                    wptr <= bin_to_gray(waddr_bin + 1);
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Read pointer logic
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                raddr_bin <= 0;
                rptr <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (rinc) begin
                    raddr_bin <= raddr_bin + 1;
                    rptr <= bin_to_gray(raddr_bin + 1);
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Synchronize write pointer to read clock domain
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                wptr_buff <= 0;
                wptr_syn <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_buff <= wptr;
                wptr_syn <= wptr_buff;
            end
        end
        
        // Synchronize read pointer to write clock domain
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                rptr_buff <= 0;
                rptr_syn <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_buff <= rptr;
                rptr_syn <= rptr_buff;
            end
        end
        
        // Write enable logic
        always @(*) begin
            if (winc && !wfull) begin
                wen = 1;
            end else begin
                wen = 0;
            end
        end
        
        // Read enable logic
        always @(*) begin
            if (rinc && !rempty) begin
                ren = 1;
            end else begin
                ren = 0;
            end
        end
        
        // Data input register
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                wdata_reg <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (wen) begin
                    wdata_reg <= wdata;
                end
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        // Implement the dual-port RAM module here
        // Connect the input and output signals to the dual-port RAM module based on the control signals and pointer values
        // Ensure proper synchronization between the write and read operations
        // Handle the full and empty conditions based on the comparison of the write and read pointers
    </implementation>
</module>
